items.title: Made by hand.
items.copy: Hallmarked 22K harams, polki chokers and matched suites — eight to fourteen weeks on the bench, fitted three times before they leave.

items.title: Gold testing.
items.copy: Bring in any gold, from anywhere. We will test its purity on the XRF while you watch, melt it or value it — at no charge, whether you bought it here or not.

items.title: One stone,
items.copy: We will put four diamonds on a tray at four price points, hand you a loupe, and explain honestly what separates them before anybody mentions money.

items.title: Three generations.
items.copy: The largest jewellery showroom in Kandivali — 1,350 sq ft, seventeen people, and a family that has weighed gold across a counter since before most of them were born.

items.title: Light enough
items.copy: Screwed backs, bezel settings and laser-welded links. Designed to survive a commute, a kitchen and a toddler — and still look like itself in ten years.
